changes: Theory workspace state is separated from retained transcript history, so tool turns do not recursively grow the mathematical artifact.
Direct model-owned workspace progress and exact source lineage are recorded without promoting diagnostics to proof or statistical acceptance.
Lean declaration inspection verifies the requested symbol and rejects an unrelated successful MCP response before indexed source fusion.
Architect feedback routing now uses a compact current-observation ACI instead of a long repeated policy essay and large history context.
The generic client-tool loop emits model-turn and tool-execution timing, including logical error, state-change, and terminal disposition metadata.

Source-ownership audit now checks explicit source-owner backedges, model-owned full-source rewrites, and exact consumer replay; ordinary statistical gate failures are not mislabeled as code-repair obligations.
Hash-bound confirmatory consumer failures return directly to the source-owning AlgorithmEngineer even after every required outer lane has been visited.
An independently accepted Simulation manifest remains visible in deferred Formalizer context, so a later formal gap cannot reopen and rerun the completed simulation lane.
Theory workspaces are explicitly told that failed scratch execution and unresolved errors have diagnostic, not empirical, authority.

Scientific, Lean, and source-grounded preflight client-tool loops request Anthropic prompt caching; a post-fix exact-Haiku live probe measured a full stable-prefix cache hit on the second Lean workspace turn.

The generic model-tool loop no longer supports rolling-history snapshots or caller-selected dynamic tool subsets. Scientific and Lean coding sessions keep one bounded linear transcript, while only the existing final-disposition recovery narrows to terminal tools.
Terminal-decision turns retain the stable provider tool schema for prompt caching while runtime execution rejects nonterminal actions after the standard budget.
Every model-facing tool observation includes only generic remaining turn/tool budget, so the same model can allocate its work without content-specific routing rules.
Scientific and Lean workspaces remember every previously executed source hash in the session and do not spend environment calls on A-to-B-to-A source cycles.
Simulation source workspaces now receive the complete frozen metric output ABI, and outcome-blind interface failures echo that exact ABI back to the same source owner.
Formalizer materialization preserves the exact model-authored Lean bytes instead of stripping trailing whitespace, so workspace, compiler, reviewer, and rejection hashes share one identity domain.
A locally compiling target fails closed when the independent exact-target reviewer is unavailable; Critic cannot substitute for that gate.
No task answer, statistical threshold, Lean grammar rule, tactic rule, repair worker, or post-runtime scheduler was added.
